entities.summary: The Sidi Bashir Mosque is a former Sufi mosque, now in partial ruins, in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Only the central gateway and two minarets survive; they are known as the Jhulta Minar or Shaking Minarets. The structure is a Monument of National Importance. Sidi Bashir Mosque is a mosque in Asia, established in 1452. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
